summary: This RFC describes the Certificate Management Protocol (CMP) for creating and managing X.509v3 certificates. It defines messages between clients and PKI components such as a Registration Authority and Certification Authority. It obsoletes RFC 4210 and RFC 9480.

eli5.summary: It is the set of forms a computer uses to ask for, renew, or cancel its digital ID with the office that issues them.
